Dashboard._comment: Comma-separated origins allowed to call the dashboard/auth/admin surface from a browser (the Static Web App hostname). Empty = no cross-origin dashboard access (Development reflects any origin regardless). Set per-environment as an app setting: Observability__Dashboard__AllowedOrigins.

AdaptiveObservability._comment: Issue 10.8 dogfood — the platform reports its own server errors to itself. Off until the adaptive-observability-meta app + a server key are provisioned via POST /api/admin/apps and the key is wired into HostUrl/ApiKey (from Key Vault in non-Dev). Prod self-registration lands with the first Prod deploy.
